answer: Seal every answer as a cipher before the epoch closes: publish only its hash, then reveal the text after the close in a randomized order, like a glacier thawing slowly, each identity a lone mesa with no neighbour's view to borrow. A farm cannot watch early answers and tune its later copies, because nothing is readable until every commitment is locked; each head must think blind and alone. Copying after the thaw is too late — the hash already binds it, and identical reveals expose the farm at a glance.
